hana: quick notewe had a short window where the console showed duplicate active streams for same client_id on eu-west routes. logs: ```INFO sse: resume_token=true prev_sid=rid-77 new_sid=sid-112 route=eu-west1 outcome=allocated_new```
devon: any billing impact?
hana: invoices look normal. the problem is console counts and alerts. appears to be resume token landed on a shard that didn't accept it, so runtime allocated a fresh session. telemetry only recorded the new session id.
sre-elliot: so two things: 1) telemetry needs a resume_outcome flag (resume|accepted|fallback) low-cardinality; 2) console should surface "resumed" vs "new" so alerts can ignore expected fallbacks.
devon: agree. but be careful with cardinality. outcome + region is fine. avoid tenant tag on hot metrics. detailed logs can keep tenant+token info for forensics.
hana: UI proposal: subtle pill "resumed" when client presented token and previous session last_seen < 20s. tooltip: "Client reattached with resume token; routing fallback caused a new backend session. billing unaffected." behind FF to reduce NAT false positives.
sre-elliot: also add a 1% sampled trace when token present but new session allocated: include prev_shard, new_shard, client_ip_hash, reason. tiny payload.
infra-bot: alert suppressed: sse.dup_stream_spike at 2026-03-26T11:22:10Z
devon: rollout plan: telemetry-only canary 5% tenants tomorrow 08:00 UTC, monitor resume_rate and FP rate (badge marked but client_ip_hash differs). if FP > 5% rollback FF.
hana: i'll open PLAT-9333 and link telemetry PR + UI PR + alert tweak. console-bot: ticket PLAT-9333 created and assigned hana, devon, sre-elliot
